_README: Re-shoot a clip from a new camera angle while holding a trained character identity: LTX 2.3 + CrossView-Warp IC-LoRA + character LoRA + MoGe-2.
ComfyUI API-format workflow. Node category: Cinematographer.
STATUS: NOT VERIFIED. This graph has never been executed. It was authored from real
node schemas (see PROVENANCE) but no ComfyUI instance was available where it was
written, so nothing here is a claim that it runs. What IS verified is structural, and
you can re-run it yourself:  python3 workflows/validate_graphs.py
That checks the file parses as JSON, that every node has class_type + inputs, that
every class_type is in a table of slot counts read from the node sources, that
every link resolves to an existing node id and a slot that node declares, that every
node supplies a legal number of inputs for its class_type, that the graph is acyclic,
and that every node is reachable from a SaveVideo. It does NOT check
that ComfyUI accepts the prompt. Treat the first run as a debugging session.
THE CHARACTER LORA. This graph is reshoot_ltx_crossview.json plus one node. Node 36 is a
LoraLoaderModelOnly carrying a character adapter trained by character_lora_train.json, and
it sits in series between the LTX 2.3 distilled LoRA (node 11) and the CrossView-Warp
IC-LoRA (node 12). The model chain is therefore:
UNETLoader -> distilled LoRA -> CHARACTER LoRA -> CrossView-Warp IC-LoRA -> CFGGuider
Order matters, and this is the order that is right. The distilled LoRA is a schedule
adapter and belongs closest to the base. The character adapter is a content adapter and
belongs after it. The IC-LoRA is a conditioning adapter that has to see the final weights,
so it goes last. All three are the same class of node and none of them replaces another.
strength_model is 0.8, which is a starting point and not a measurement: too low and the
identity drifts, too high and the adapter fights the camera move.
The CrossView-Warp wiring is untouched. Nodes 1-35 are identical to
reshoot_ltx_crossview.json; the only two changes are the new node 36 and node 12's `model`
input, which now reads slot 0 of node 36 instead of slot 0 of node 11.
THE ADAPTER MUST BE TRAINED ON LTX 2.3 22B. A LoRA is a set of low-rank deltas against one
base's attention and projection weights and will not load usefully into a different base.
Do not point node 36 at an adapter trained on an image model, and do not point it at a 2.5
adapter: LTX 2.5 changed the text encoder (Gemma 3 12B -> Gemma 4 12B) and the
text-projection layer, so 2.3 and 2.5 adapters are not interchangeable.
NO LORA HAS BEEN TRAINED. The filename node 36 names is a placeholder; the app overwrites
it on every request, and until character_lora_train.json has actually been run there is
nothing at that path. This graph has never been executed either.
PROVENANCE. Derived from the CrossView-Warp v2 example workflow shipped by the node
pack's own author:
cseti007/ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp  example_workflows/ltx2.3-ic-lora-crossview-warp-v2.json
(Apache-2.0; 119 UI-format nodes; read 2026-10-29)
That file is ComfyUI UI format. It was converted to API format by hand, using input
names read from the actual node sources rather than guessed:
ComfyUI master  comfy_extras/nodes_lt.py             EmptyLTXVLatentVideo, LTXVConditioning,
LTXVCropGuides, LTXVConcatAVLatent,
LTXVSeparateAVLatent
ComfyUI master  comfy_extras/nodes_lt_audio.py       LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, LTXVAudioVAEDecode
ComfyUI master  comfy_extras/nodes_moge.py           LoadMoGeModel, MoGeInference
ComfyUI master  comfy_extras/nodes_video.py          LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents,
CreateVideo, SaveVideo
ComfyUI master  comfy_extras/nodes_custom_sampler.py CFGGuider, KSamplerSelect, ManualSigmas,
RandomNoise, SamplerCustomAdvanced
ComfyUI master  nodes.py                             ImageScale
Lightricks      ComfyUI-LTXVideo/iclora.py           LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly,
LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide
Cseti           ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp/crossview_warp_node.py   CrossViewWarp
DELIBERATE DELTAS from that example workflow, and only these:
1. The two-stage latent-upscale pass is removed. The example samples at low
resolution, runs LTXVLatentUpsampler, then samples again. This graph does a
single 1376x768 pass: fewer moving parts, one fewer weight to download, and the
framing arithmetic this entry is about is resolution-independent.
2. The example's comparison plumbing (SetNode/GetNode/AddLabel/ImageConcatMulti/
ReverseImageBatch and the second sampler chain) is dropped. It exists to show a
side-by-side in the author's demo, not to make a clip.
3. VHS_LoadVideo / VHS_VideoCombine (VideoHelperSuite) are replaced with core
LoadVideo / GetVideoComponents / CreateVideo / SaveVideo. One fewer custom node
pack in the critical path.
4. The camera is a keyframed move that stays inside the green reliability zone
(|azimuth| <= 40 deg, elevation 0..+15 deg) instead of the example's
-24.4 -> +50.4 deg swing. The +50.4 deg endpoint is outside the +/-45 deg range
the LoRA was checked on, so CameraReliabilityZone grades it yellow. Replace the
`keyframes` string on node 6 to reproduce the example's move.
5. keep_source_aim is ON. The node's own README says it scores better and it is what
a re-shoot wants: the camera orbits, the aim holds.
6. preview_size 384 -> 512; frame_index 49 -> 1.
7. filename_prefix -> cinematographer/*, to namespace our outputs.
8. The positive prompt is an obvious placeholder that still carries the LoRA's
trigger word. If a generated clip ever shows PLACEHOLDER_POSITIVE_PROMPT_
INJECTION_DID_NOT_RUN, injection did not run; that is the signal it is there for.
9. LoadVideo.file is a placeholder filename. The app overwrites it with the uploaded
clip on every request.
10. roll_lock / frame_count / interpolation are passed explicitly. The node keeps
those widget slots (hidden and ignored) because ComfyUI stores widget values
positionally; passing them by name is harmless and keeps the file diffable
against a future re-export.
11. One node added: 36, LoraLoaderModelOnly, the character adapter. See THE CHARACTER
LORA above. Nothing else in the graph changed.
WHAT IS VERIFIED vs NOT:
VERIFIED      valid JSON; class_type + inputs on every node; every link resolves to
an existing node id and a declared output slot; acyclic.
NOT VERIFIED  that ComfyUI accepts this prompt; that the node packs and weights below
are installed; that it produces a clip; that the clip matches the
requested angle. None of that has been run.
REQUIRED NODE PACKS (custom):
ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp   (Apache-2.0)   CrossViewWarp
ComfyUI-LTXVideo        (Lightricks)   LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly, LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide
Everything else is ComfyUI core.
REQUIRED WEIGHTS (paths as ComfyUI names them):
models/diffusion_models/LTX2/ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_int8_convrot.safetensors
models/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
models/text_encoders/LTX2/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors
models/vae/ltx2/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors
models/vae/ltx2/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors
models/loras/LTX2/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_111_bf16.safetensors
models/loras/LTX2/LTX2.3-22B_IC-LoRA-CrossView-Warp_v2_6000.safetensors
models/geometry_estimation/moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors
models/loras/cinematographer/character.safetensors
(trained by character_lora_train.json; placeholder path, the app overwrites it)
LICENCE. LTX 2.3 weights are LTX-2.x Community (revenue-capped); CrossView-Warp and
its node pack are Apache-2.0; MoGe-2 is open. No MiniMax H3 and no closed API in the
critical path. See reshoot_wan22_fun_control.json for the Apache-2.0-only alternative.
MEASURED: nothing. No timing, no VRAM figure, no output. The reference app this is
modelled on was demonstrated on a 96 GB GPU; this LTX path is lighter, but that is an
expectation, not a measurement.
